name: building-lbo-models
description: Builds and reviews leveraged buyout (LBO) models for financial sponsor acquisitions: sources and uses with transaction fees, financing fees, OID and cash to balance sheet; an EBITDA bridge reconciling reported, management-adjusted or QoE EBITDA to credit agreement Consolidated EBITDA; operating projections and free cash flow; a debt schedule by tranche with mandatory amortization, excess cash flow sweep, minimum cash, revolver draws and average-balance interest circularity; cash taxes with the IRC 163(j) business interest limit, NOL and Section 382 limits; exit scenarios; sponsor returns as dated IRR (XIRR) and MOIC; sensitivity tables; credit statistics and covenant headroom; and tie-out checks (sources equal uses, debt rolls forward, balance sheet balances, cash ties). Use for LBO model, leveraged buyout, paper LBO, sponsor returns, equity check, debt capacity, cash sweep, IRR, MOIC, private equity acquisition model, or reviewing a sponsor or lender model. Outputs are drafts for qualified finance review.
